title: Zero Trust maturity
heading:
How far along is your
Zero Trust journey?
lead: Six quick questions across the Zero Trust pillars show how mature your never-trust-always-verify approach is, and where to focus next.

items.name: Identity
items.q: Is every access decision tied to a verified identity?
opts: Strong identity with MFA on important access.
Continuous, risk-based verification for every request.

items.name: Devices
items.q: Is device health checked before granting access?
opts: Device compliance is checked for key access.
Access always conditional on verified device posture.

items.name: Network
items.q: Is the network segmented to limit lateral movement?

items.name: Applications & workloads
items.q: Are applications protected by explicit, per-request authorisation?
opts: Continuous authorisation enforced for every workload.

items.name: Data
items.q: Is data classified and access to it controlled?
opts: Classification driving encryption and least-privilege access.

items.name: Visibility & automation
items.q: Do you have the visibility and automation to enforce all of this?
opts: Full telemetry with automated policy enforcement and response.
